title: Animated Skeleton
subtitle: Placeholders that shimmer while content loads.

descriptions.animation: Loading effect drawn across the placeholders.
descriptions.duration: Length of one loading cycle, in seconds. Not used when Animation is None.
descriptions.stagger: Offset between placeholders so they don't pulse in sync, in seconds. Not used when Animation is None.
descriptions.swapAnimation: How the real content appears when loading finishes.
descriptions.swapDuration: How long the real content takes to appear, in seconds. Not used when Swap animation is None.
descriptions.swapStagger: Delay between content items appearing, in seconds. Not used when Swap animation is None.
descriptions.loadTime: How long the Replay button pretends to load before showing the content, in seconds. The first load always takes 3 s.
